gumtree_entries.description: UPDATED o2 -> i15: Undeclared exception!
DELETED o3: Duplicate key in uniquely indexed collection.
ADDED i2: retainAll on a non-empty unique collection against an empty retain-set removes all elements and returns true (collection was modified).
ADDED i3: retainAll on an empty non-unique collection against an equally empty retain-set makes no change and returns false.
ADDED i4: removeIf with a predicate that never matches (NullPredicate) leaves the collection unchanged and returns false.
ADDED i5: removeIf with a predicate that always matches (TruePredicate) removes all elements and returns true.
ADDED i6: removeIf with a null java.util.function.Predicate returns false without modifying the collection (null filter is treated as a no-op).
ADDED i7: Removing an element that is not present in the collection returns false.
ADDED i8: get() returns null when the given key has no associated element in the index.
ADDED i9: constTransformer itself is not a key in the index (the collection is empty)
ADDED i10: containsAll returns false when an element is present in the query collection but was added to the backing list directly (bypassing the index), so the index does
ADDED i11: Added directly to the backing list – the index is unaware of this element
ADDED i12: containsAll returns true when every element in the query collection was added through the indexed collection (so the index is up to date).
ADDED i13: Adding an element whose key already exists in a unique indexed collection throws IllegalArgumentException with a "Duplicate key" message.
ADDED i14: Pre-populate with one element so the null key is already indexed
ADDED i16: addAll copies elements from one indexed collection into another, indexing each element via the target collection's key transformer.
ADDED i17: Populate source via its backing list directly (index rebuilt on construction)
ADDED i18: values() returns null when the given key has no associated elements in the index.
ADDED i19: nullKeyTransformer itself is not a key that was ever indexed
ADDED i20: clear() empties both the decorated collection and the internal index without throwing any exception.
ADDED i21: removeAll removes all elements that appear in the given collection and returns true when at least one element was removed.
ADDED i22: Add directly to backing list so there is something to remove
